evidence.claim: Graph-feature scorer trained on 5,565 closed cases gives this transaction a calibrated fraud probability of 0.01 (bank model score 0.52); features include Vesta's unnamed C, D, M and V columns, used as signals only
Device profile 'Trident/7.0 | Windows 10 | ie 11.0 for desktop | 1920x1080' is marked New and has never been used on C12265-K2
Card history holds 2 earlier closed cases (2 confirmed fraud, 0 cleared); most recent CC-2447 (account_takeover, confirmed_fraud)

Known-pattern definition matched to this case: Out-of-region use. Card-present purchases in a billing region the cardholder has no history in, while their normal activity continues at home. Several days of purchases in one new region is a trip, not a clone. Policy R2, R3.
Closed cases whose analyst notes read most like this investigation (vector search over ClosedCase.note_emb): CC-3942, CC-1960, CC-0241, CC-4521

case.summary: Model score 0.52 triggered review of $125.08 online transaction on Dec 3, 2016. Graph-based fraud probability: 0.01 (calibrated from model on 5,565 closed cases). Card history includes 2 prior confirmed fraud cases, but transaction pattern matches known out-of-region travel behavior (legitimate trip, not account clone). Verdict: legitimate; transaction allowed and case closed.

stop_reason: Probability 0.01 with 2 independent signals meets the §6 stopping rule; the risk score alone did not hold up.
